ValidationRule.description: This validation rule triggers if user changes the record type .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), ISCHANGED( RecordType_Name__c ), OR( AND( PRIORVALUE(RecordType_Name__c ) = "IME SC Case", NOT($RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case Resolved") ) , PRIORVALUE(RecordType_Name__c ) = "IME SC Case Resolved" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorized to change the record type .
